chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

Al-ʿAbbas came to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام and said: “O Ali, the people have gathered intending to bury Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in the Baqiʿ of the prayer place, and that a man from among them should lead them.”

So Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام came out to the people and said: “O people, Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله is an Imam, living and dead, and he said: ‘I shall be buried in the place wherein I am taken.’”
Then he said: “At the door, so perform salat upon him.” Then he instructed the people to pray upon him ten by ten, and then they would depart.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام in this report
key_terms.أُقْبَضُ: I am taken, meaning the moment of death
key_terms.إِمَامٌ: leader vested with authority, here affirming the Prophet’s continuing status
key_terms.الْبُقْعَةِ: the specific spot or place where burial was to occur
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: Rasul Allah, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.يُصَلُّونَ: they perform salat, here the funeral prayer upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: How was Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله buried and how was the funeral salat organized according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts how Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام addressed the people after the demise of Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, affirming that the Prophet remains the Imam both in life and after death. It also records that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was to be buried where he passed away, and that the people were instructed to enter in groups to perform salat upon him.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Al-Abbas came over to Amir Al-Momineenasws, so he said, ‘O Aliasws! The people are gathering that they would be burning Rasool-Allahsaww in the spot of the Praying place, and that a man from them would be leading the (funeral) Salat.

So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> came out to the people and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O you people! Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> is an Imam<sup>asws</sup>, be he<sup>saww</sup> alive or expired, and he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> want to be buried in the spot in which I<sup>saww</sup> would pass away’.
Then heasws said: ‘(Come) at the door, so pray Salat upon himsaww’.
Then heasws instructed the people, ten by ten to be praying Salat upon himsaww. Then they went out’.
en.sarwar: 36. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Al-‘Abbass came to Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and said, “O Ali, people have come in a group to bury the Messenger of Allah in Baqi‘, the prayer place.
Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) them came out to the people and said, “O people, the Messenger of Allah is the Imam whether dead or living. He had said that he must be buried in the place where he died..
He then stood at the door and prayed for him. Then he commanded every ten people to come in and pray for him and come out”
